'''Fabricio de Melo''' (born June 20, 1990) is a [[Brazil|Brazilian]] basketball player who played college basketball for [[Syracuse University]]. He declared his eligibility for [[2012 NBA Draft]].

==College career==
Melo played two seasons at [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse University]]. He was named the [[Big East Conference|Big East]] Defensive Player of the Year in his sophomore season. He was declared ineligible for the [[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2012 NCAA Tournament]] because of academic reasons.

==Professional career==
Melo decided to forgo his final two years at Syracuse and declared himself eligible for [[2012 NBA Draft]].<ref>[http://www.sfgate.com/cgi-bin/article.cgi?f=/c/a/2012/04/06/SPV41NVF7E.DTL Fab Melo leaving Syracuse for NBA]</ref>
